title: Affect, the means by which an organism registers its own state

statements.text: Affect is the means by which organisms register their own states: it registers the state of the subject, not primarily of objects. Affects are feelings such as hunger, lust and surprise, which can exist apart from perceptual or cognitive representations and arise even without a cortex. Affect is the technical term for the function of feeling.
